description: Step 1 of a new search («Компания»): reads the user's company site (url) or a text about it and writes a short plain-language description of what it sells, to whom and why it matters. The user may edit it before create_search. Takes up to a minute. Part of a new search's onboarding: the first assistant call of an onboarding spends one brief (a free account has one search brief and may call each assistant once); pass the returned onboarding_id to the next calls and to create_search. [REST: POST /api/assist/company]

onboarding_id.description: The onboarding id that ties the assistant calls and create_search into ONE brief. Omit it on the first call: the answer gives one; pass it to every later assistant call and to create_search of the same new search.

text.description: Or: a text about the company.

name: suggest_company_description
title: Describe the company (onboarding step 1)
